mailboxId.description: Mailbox public_id returned by list_mailboxes (preferred); hosted alias id or current email also works.

emailId.description: Message id returned by list_emails or search_emails.

query.description: Optional safe-read controls: metadata_only, action_metadata_only, agent_safe_content, include_held, require_scan_status, and max_body_chars. action_metadata_only omits message content and returns bounded, server-derived reply_targets for safe action preflight. A scan-status mismatch returns safe metadata with content_omitted and content_omission_reason instead of a false not-found. Use metadata_only before reading untrusted content; include_held only for the active verification flow. Only sender_authentication.status=pass may be described as authenticated.

include_held.description: Use true only for the active verification flow.

metadata_only.description: Use true to omit body, snippet, raw headers, and threat URLs.

action_metadata_only.description: Omit message content and return bounded, server-derived reply_targets for safe action preflight.

require_scan_status.description: Require the stored message scan status to match before returning it.

max_body_chars.description: Optional positive character cap for the returned body. The agent-inbox profile enforces 12000.

agent_safe_content.description: Omit sensitive metadata and storage diagnostics, and normalize untrusted text fields to bounded plain text.

body.description: JSON body for the Sold API operation.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional API-metering idempotency key. Reuse only with the identical method, path, query, and body. Mailbox creation returns the existing matching mailbox on replay; other mutation replays return a conflict instead of executing twice.
